code: local P=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui local done=workspace:GetAttribute('QADone') or '' local pref={"모험 시작","이어하기","시작","퀘스트","인벤","스킬","상점","지도"} local skip={"삭제","초기화","나가기","종료","구매 확정","결제","Robux","로벅스"} local vp=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize local function shown(d) local x=d while x and x~=P do if x:IsA('GuiObject') and not x.Visible then return false end if x:IsA('LayerCollector') and not x.Enabled then return false end x=x.Parent end return x==P end local function label(d) if d:IsA('TextButton') and d.Text~='' then return (d.Text:gsub('\n',' ')) end for _,c in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do if c:IsA('TextLabel') and c.Text~='' then return c.Text end end return d.Name end local best,bs=nil,-1 for _,d in ipairs(P:GetDescendants()) do if (d:IsA('TextButton') or d:IsA('ImageButton')) and d.AbsoluteSize.X>8 and d.AbsoluteSize.Y>8 and shown(d) and d.AbsolutePosition.X>=0 and d.AbsolutePosition.Y>=0 and d.AbsolutePosition.X<vp.X and d.AbsolutePosition.Y<vp.Y then local l=label(d) local key=l..'@'..math.floor(d.AbsolutePosition.X/20)..','..math.floor(d.AbsolutePosition.Y/20) local bad=false for _,s in ipairs(skip) do if string.find(l,s,1,true) then bad=true end end if not bad and not string.find(done,key,1,true) then local sc=0 for i,p in ipairs(pref) do if string.find(l,p,1,true) then sc=100-i end end if sc>bs then bs=sc best=d end end end end if not best then return 'NONE' end local l=label(best) local key=l..'@'..math.floor(best.AbsolutePosition.X/20)..','..math.floor(best.AbsolutePosition.Y/20) workspace:SetAttribute('QADone',done..'|'..key) return string.format('%d,%d CLICK=%s',math.floor(best.AbsolutePosition.X+best.AbsoluteSize.X/2),math.floor(best.AbsolutePosition.Y+best.AbsoluteSize.Y/2+36),l)
